event_note: Apple FQ4 2026 (Sept quarter) results Mon 2026-11-02 after the close, call 2:00 pm PT / 5:00 pm ET, first call led by CEO John Ternus (took over 2026-09-01) with CFO Kevan Parekh. Apple's own IR page did not render a date through WebFetch; confirmed instead by 9to5Mac 2026-10-06 (https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/06/apple-sets-q4-2026-earnings-release-for-november-2/), MacDailyNews 2026-10-07 and a Reuters preview dated 2026-11-02 (https://www.marketscreener.com/news/apple-s-new-ceo-ternus-to-face-first-earnings-test-as-memory-costs-surge-ce785fd8dc88f42c). Session amc. EDGAR shows the last 2.02 8-K on 2026-07-30, so the print has not happened before today.
conviction_note: The reported quarter should land near the top of Apple's own 9-11% guide, where consensus already sits, so the stock moves on the December-quarter guide (consensus ~$152B, +5.7% on a record $143.8B comp with no base iPhone 18). The proxies on that guide lean slightly negative: Pro component orders cut, global Pro sell-through only +3.1%, Duo supply short with replacements eating stock, memory still rising. But the put skew is at its 86th percentile and the stock fell 1-2% on the day, so much of that downside is hedged. Net p_up 46 on a 4.0% absolute move gives -0.32. The findings sum to -0.65. Both measurements say the same thing: a slight negative lean on a guide-driven print, with no decisive number.
bar: Sept-quarter revenue $113.39B (LSEG via Reuters 2026-11-02, https://www.marketscreener.com/news/apple-s-new-ceo-ternus-to-face-first-earnings-test-as-memory-costs-surge-ce785fd8dc88f42c) and $113.38B (MarketBeat via ifyouspent, https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/apple-earnings-what-to-watch-november-2026). Two sources agree. EPS $1.99. iPhone $56.54B (+15%). Services $31.56B (+10%, the slowest in more than three years). Company guide from 2026-07-30: revenue +9-11% YoY on a $102.5B base, i.e. $111.7-113.8B, so consensus sits near the top. Gross margin guide 47-48%, including ~1pt of tariff refunds. Opex $19.1-19.4B. FX headwind 2.5pts (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/apple-earnings-live-updates.html). The prior guide (June quarter, 14-17%) printed +16%, inside the range. December-quarter consensus is NOT settled: $151.96B revenue / $2.90 EPS in one source (https://ph.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/apple-earnings-outlook-guidance-not-the-beat-is-the-key-variable-93CH-2668062) against ~$153.4B in another. Goldman is below at $151.2B, $2.88 EPS and 46.8% gross margin, low-to-mid single-digit growth (https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262260328-apple-stock-forecast-q4-earnings-preview-iphone-duo-memory-costs-352-resistance-october-31-2026-tradingkey). The December comp is $143.8B, with iPhone $85.3B (+23%) and Greater China +38% (https://www.macrumors.com/2026/01/29/apple-1q-2026-earnings). Guide-dependent findings are capped small because the December bar is disputed.
positioning_check: Short interest 131.6M shares on 2026-10-15, 0.90% of float, +9% vs 09-30, 3.7 days to cover (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/AAPL/short-interest): not crowded, so no squeeze mechanism. Options snapshot 2026-10-30 (https://www.thetrading.tools/aapl-options): 25-delta put IV 5.5 vol points over the call, 86th percentile since 2024 and up from +2.5 a month earlier. 30d IV 29.3% against 14.5% realised. The Nov-6 expiry carries 43.7% IV. Put/call OI on expiries within 7 days is 1.20. Implied earnings move: ±4.0% (https://earnings-watcher.com/wiki/earnings-implied-moves-2026-11-02, 2026-11-02) and ±3.3% (https://apexvol.com/earnings/aapl, 2026-11-02). Run-up: +27% YTD and +28% since 2026-04-20, with a record close of $348.91 on 10-29. The stock traded down 1.2-2.1% on 11-02 into the print ($337-345). Reaction history, because the baseline is empty: per apexvol the last 12 next-close moves were -7.3, +3.2, +0.5, -0.4, -2.5, -3.7, -0.7, -1.3, +0.7, +6.0, -0.5, -0.5. Median absolute ~0.9%, mean ~2.3%. The two big moves (-7.3% on a guide miss in July 2026, +6.0%) both came on guidance.

findings.finding: Apple's December-quarter iPhone guide faces a $85.3B (+23%) comp with no base iPhone 18 this fall. Nikkei (2026-10-09) reported October iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max component orders cut 15-20% from Apple's original requests on soft demand; Securities Times says Pro Max +10-15% and Pro -10-15%, total flat. Counterpoint's first-three-weeks sell-through for the 18 Pro series is +3.1% globally (US -4%, Japan -27%, China +29%). Consensus December revenue of ~$152B (+5.7%) needs iPhone roughly flat to up on that comp.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide is the line Apple trades on. July 2026: guide of 9-11% against ~12% expected, -7.3% next close (apexvol) after a beat. April 2026: guide of 14-17% above estimates, +3.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: The order-cut story is public and the stock went on to a record close on 10-29, so the market largely looked through it. What is not priced is how Apple frames the comp in the guide. A priced version would show December consensus at or below Goldman's $151.2B rather than $152-153B. Put skew at the 86th percentile says some of this is hedged.
findings.independence: Counterpoint 3-week sell-through, a different firm and dataset (https://www.neoteo.com/en/counterpoint-estimates-iphone-18-pro-sales-rose-31-globally-while-the-us-fell-4, 2026-10-28). Counterpoint China note expecting this generation to sell below the last in Q4 (https://counterpointresearch.com/en/insights/iphone-18-pro-series-sales-up-12-percent-yoy-in-launch-week-in-china-as-apple-takes-hashtag-1-spot, 2026-09-30). Counter-evidence is folded into the size: China +29% and total Pro orders flat per Securities Times (https://www.sammyfans.com/2026/10/10/apple-boosts-duo-and-pro-max-orders-while-cutting-iphone-18-pro-orders/amp/). Nikkei itself says a $100 higher Pro price means lower units do not immediately lower revenue.

findings.finding: iPhone Duo ($1,999, on sale 10-23) is supply-limited. BofA puts average delivery waits at 79 days, with shipments into January. Apple said on ~10-26/27 it will replace Duo units with inner-display cracks, and reports say replacement stock is drawing on already depleted inventory. So less Duo revenue lands in the December quarter than Counterpoint's ~6M-units-this-year figure implies.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Supply-constraint commentary in the July 2026 guide was cited as a cause of the -7.3% move. Apple has historically guided through iPhone supply constraints (January 2026: 'currently constrained').
findings.why_not_priced: The crack story broke 10-25 to 10-27. The stock still closed at a record on 10-29, so it was read as a product story, not a guide input. A priced version would show December revenue estimates trimmed after 10-27; the only cut on record is Goldman's, and it predates the replacements.
findings.independence: Reuters preview citing BofA's 79-day wait and IDC's Popal on demand exceeding supply (https://www.marketscreener.com/news/apple-s-new-ceo-ternus-to-face-first-earnings-test-as-memory-costs-surge-ce785fd8dc88f42c, 2026-11-02). Apple's statement on replacements via KSL/AP (https://www.ksl.com/article/51641303/apple-says-it-will-replace-iphone-duo-units-showing-screen-problems). Two-sided: the shortage reflects demand above supply, so revenue is deferred rather than lost. Sized small for that reason.

findings.finding: Memory costs are still rising into the December quarter. SK hynix's Q3 2026 DRAM ASP was up high-20s % QoQ and it sees shortages through 2030. TrendForce sees Q4 conventional DRAM contracts +10-15% and Q3 mobile DRAM +8-13% QoQ, though it expects Q4 mobile increases to narrow. Apple said in July it expects 'to pay even higher memory costs', and its own Sept-quarter GM guide is ~46-47% ex-refunds. The December GM guide risks landing below Goldman's 46.8%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July 2026 sell-off was attributed to memory costs plus the guide (https://www.euronews.com/business/2026/07/31/apple-shares-fall-despite-record-revenue-as-outlook-disappoints).
findings.why_not_priced: Every preview names memory, so the direction is priced. The level is not: no source carries a December GM consensus except Goldman's 46.8%. If the market had priced a sub-46% guide, Goldman's number would not be the low end of the visible range.
findings.independence: TrendForce mobile DRAM 3Q26 report (https://www.trendforce.com/research/download/RP260803NC, 2026-08-03), a different firm. It also contains the counter-point that Q4 mobile increases narrow, folded into the size. CNBC on Apple's July comments (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/apple-earnings-live-updates.html).

findings.finding: Third-party trackers put calendar Q3 2026 iPhone units at 56.5M, flat YoY (Omdia, 2026-10-29), or -4% (IDC), against Apple's guide of mid-teens iPhone revenue growth (consensus $56.54B, +15%). Omdia says channel partners stocked up ahead of expected price increases, and the 18 Pro/Pro Max carry +$100 list prices, so the guide holds only on ASP and channel fill.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Apple's reported-quarter beats have been sold or ignored. EPS beat in each of the last six to eight quarters while three of the last six reactions were negative (investing.com preview).
findings.why_not_priced: Unit trackers are public. This finding lands inside Apple's own guided range and is sized near zero for that reason. A priced version would show iPhone consensus below the guided mid-teens, and it is not.
findings.independence: IDC -4% via 9to5Mac/ithinkdiff; Counterpoint's Q3 note says Apple's volume fell partly because there was no base-iPhone-18 channel fill (https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/12/iphone-hits-record-q3-shipment-share-as-global-smartphone-market-plunges-20-per-report/, 2026-10-12).

findings.finding: App Store trend into the Sept quarter is soft. UBS/Sensor Tower: June-quarter App Store +3% reported (US -6%). Sensor Tower via FT: US commission revenue down 18% since the start of 2026. Services consensus already assumes +10% ($31.56B), the slowest in more than three years.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved instance found of this name moving on a Services-only miss. Services decelerations have been folded into guide reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: consensus already shows the slowest Services growth in three years. No Sept-quarter Sensor Tower data was found, so whether July-September softened further is unknown. UBS noted an easier ~10% comp.
findings.independence: UBS June-quarter note (https://www.mactech.com/2026/07/07/apple-app-store-revenue-growth-slowed-in-the-june-2026-quarter/, 2026-07-07). Both rest on Sensor Tower data, so treat them as one source.

findings.finding: Mac shipments in calendar Q3 2026 fell 11.3% YoY to 5.9M (IDC). Omdia and Counterpoint also show ~-11%. Apple raised Mac prices in late June, and the July guide flagged supply constraints on Mac.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Mac (~9% of revenue) has not moved this stock alone in the resolved record found.
findings.why_not_priced: Inside the guided constraint and offset by price increases. Net of the other ~91% of revenue it is nearly zero.

findings.finding: TSMC's Q3 2026 smartphone revenue rose 10% QoQ to 21% of sales, and its Q4 guide of $52.3-54.3B came in above the ~$49.1B expected. The upstream supplier of Apple's A-series/M-series silicon is building into Apple's December quarter, not cutting.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None specific; supplier read-throughs have not been a measured driver for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: A proxy: TSMC's Q4 is HPC-led (68% of revenue), so the smartphone line is a weak read on Apple, and it was public a fortnight before the print. Sized small.
findings.independence: HL note on the Q4 guide vs expectations (https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/share-research/tsmc-q3-results-strong-quarter-record-guidance). It cuts against the Nikkei order-cut finding, which is why both are small.

findings.finding: Into the print the downside is hedged. 25-delta put skew is +5.5 vol (86th percentile since 2024, up from +2.5 a month earlier). Put/call OI on expiries within 7 days is 1.20. The stock fell 1.2-2.1% on 11-02 to ~$337-345, off a record $348.91 on 10-29. Short interest is only 0.9% of float, so there is no squeeze, but a guide that is merely 'not worse than feared' meets bought protection.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: April 2026, guide above estimates: +3.2%. July 2026, guide below: -7.3%. Skew history around those prints was not found.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is by definition priced as a level. What it changes is the asymmetry of the reaction: a skew at the 86th percentile means the negative findings above are partly paid for. If the market were complacent, skew would sit near its median and the stock would not have sold off on print day.
findings.independence: Day-of price action from the Reuters page (https://www.marketscreener.com/news/apple-s-new-ceo-ternus-to-face-first-earnings-test-as-memory-costs-surge-ce785fd8dc88f42c) and short interest from MarketBeat (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/AAPL/short-interest).

baseline_tension: The baseline is empty (bars failed). Against the market's own statements, the negative guide lean AGREES with an elevated put skew (86th percentile) and a print-day sell-off, so it is probably partly priced. The +27% YTD run-up to a record cuts the other way: it leaves room to fall on a weak guide. Net, both pull p_up only slightly below 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar): the December-quarter consensus has two disagreeing sources ($151.96B vs ~$153.4B), so the guide findings were capped small. Memory went -0.4 -> -0.3 because its only GM bar is Goldman's 46.8%.

Rule 6 (inside the guide): the iPhone-units and Mac findings land inside Apple's own guided range, so units went -0.2 -> -0.1 and Mac -0.1 -> -0.05. Services went -0.15 -> -0.1 because consensus already carries the slowest growth in three years.
Rule 7 / definition (agreeing with a strong skew is probably priced): the iPhone December finding went -0.5 -> -0.4, applied once. p_up went 45 -> 46.
Rule 3 (own caveat): the Duo finding's text says the revenue is deferred, not lost, so it went -0.3 -> -0.2.
'Asking what was missed generates pessimism': I re-checked for positives and the hedged-positioning +0.4 and TSMC +0.1 stand. No finding was dropped. The scaled number moved -0.4 -> -0.32.
